# IntSlider { #anylumino.IntSlider }

```python
IntSlider(
    value=0,
    min=0,
    max=100,
    step=1,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
    continuous_update=True,
    orientation='horizontal',
    readout=True,
    readout_format='d',
    **kwargs,
)
```

Integer slider control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type     | Description                                                           | Default        |
|-------------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------|
| value             | optional | Initial value and synced Python value.                                | `0`            |
| min               | optional | Minimum numeric, date, or time value.                                 | `0`            |
| max               | optional | Maximum numeric, date, or time value.                                 | `100`          |
| step              | optional | Increment size.                                                       | `1`            |
| description       | optional | Label shown above the control.                                        | `''`           |
| disabled          | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled.                                 | `False`        |
| continuous_update | optional | Whether Python receives updates while the user is typing or dragging. | `True`         |
| orientation       | optional | ``'horizontal'`` or ``'vertical'``.                                   | `'horizontal'` |
| readout           | optional | Whether to show the current value.                                    | `True`         |
| readout_format    | optional | Format string used for slider readouts.                               | `'d'`          |
